11: The UN partition plan. On November 29 the General Assembly votes for a Jewish state and an Arab state. The Jews accept and the Arabs reject. MAP 11 Natan Alterman publishes The Silver Platter. The poem honors those who will pay the price of statehood.

1949 Feb 24 to Jul 20 The armistice lines. Armistice agreements with Egypt (Feb 24), Lebanon (Mar 23), Jordan (Apr 3) and Syria (Jul 20) end the War of Independence. Israel holds more land than the partition plan gave it. MAPS 12, 14

1940 Aug Avraham Stern founds Lehi, an armed underground group.
1940 Sep 9 Italian bombers kill 137 people in Tel Aviv.

1941 Marcel Janco, a founder of Dada, arrives from Romania.
1941 May 15 The Palmach is formed as the Haganah’s strike force.
1941 Jun 1 to 2 A mob kills about 180 Jews in the Farhud in Baghdad.
1941 Jun 8 Moshe Dayan loses an eye fighting Vichy forces in Lebanon.
1942 The Biltmore Conference calls for a Jewish commonwealth.
1942 Feb 24 The refugee ship Struma is sunk and 781 die.
1942 Nov Palestine’s Jews learn of the mass murder in Europe.
1943 Apr 19 The Warsaw Ghetto uprising begins.
1944 The Jewish Brigade is formed in the British army.
1944 Feb 1 The Irgun declares a revolt against British rule.
1944 Nov 6 Lehi assassinates Lord Moyne in Cairo.
1944 Nov 7 Hannah Szenes is executed in Budapest.
1945 The violinist Itzhak Perlman is born in Tel Aviv.

1950 to 1952 Operation Ezra and Nehemiah. Airlifts bring about 120,000 Jews from Iraq to Israel. The reparations agreement. Israel and West Germany sign in Luxembourg. Menachem Begin leads a violent protest outside the Knesset in January over the talks.

1956 Oct 29 to Nov 7 The Sinai War. After Egypt nationalizes the Suez Canal, Israel, Britain and France plan the attack in secret at Sèvres. Israel takes Sinai in days. The United States and the Soviet Union force a withdrawal, completed in March 1957.

1951 Sep Egypt bars Israeli shipping from the Suez Canal.
1952 Jul The Free Officers coup in Egypt brings Nasser to power.
1952 Nov Chaim Weizmann dies.

1953 The Israel Prize is created.
1953 Oct The Qibya raid draws sharp international criticism.
1953 Dec Ben-Gurion resigns and moves to Sde Boker.
1954 Jan 26 Moshe Sharett becomes prime minister while Ben-Gurion rests at Sde Boker.
1954 Mar Gunmen kill 11 Israelis on a bus at Scorpion Pass.
1950s to 1960s Jews arrive from Arab countries and Iran and reshape Israeli society.
1955 Yehuda Amichai publishes his first poems, Now and in Other Days.

1955 Nov 3 Ben-Gurion returns as prime minister.

1967 Jun 7 Jerusalem reunited. Israeli forces take the Old City, the Western Wall and the rest of Judea and Samaria, Sinai, Gaza and the Golan Heights.
1967 Nov 22 Resolution 242. The UN Security Council calls for Israeli withdrawal from territories and for peace and secure borders. Arab leaders had already declared three refusals at Khartoum.

1967 Jun 8 to 1970 Aug 7 The War of Attrition. Egypt shells Israeli positions along the Suez Canal and Israel answers with air raids deep in Egypt. The fighting is heaviest from March 1969 and a ceasefire takes hold on August 7, 1970.
1969 Mar 17 Golda Meir becomes prime minister. She follows Levi Eshkol, who died in office on February 26. She resigns in April 1974 after the Yom Kippur War.
1961 Aug 15 Election: Mapai wins 42 seats.
1962 Marc Chagall’s windows are dedicated at the Hadassah synagogue in Jerusalem.
1963 Jun 26 Levi Eshkol succeeds David Ben-Gurion as prime minister.
1964 The Arab League founds the PLO.
1964 The National Water Carrier brings Galilee water to the south.
1964 Ephraim Kishon’s film Sallah Shabati is the first Israeli film nominated for an Academy Award.
1964 Jan Pope Paul VI makes the first papal visit to the Holy Land in modern times.
1965 Israel and West Germany establish diplomatic relations.
1965 The Israel Museum opens in Jerusalem, with the Shrine of the Book.
1965 May Israeli spy Eli Cohen is hanged in Damascus.
1965 Nov 2 Election: Alignment wins 45 seats.
1966 S. Y. Agnon wins the Nobel Prize in Literature.
1966 Dec Military rule over Arab citizens of Israel ends.
1967 Naomi Shemer writes “Jerusalem of Gold”.
1967 May Egypt closes the Straits of Tiran to Israeli shipping. MAP 17
1967 Jun Moshe Dayan becomes defense minister days before the Six-Day War.
1967 Jun Israeli aircraft and torpedo boats attack the American ship USS Liberty.
1967 Jun 28 Territory: Israel extends its law and administration to East Jerusalem.
1967 Sep Settlers return to Kfar Etzion, the first Israeli settlement after the war.
1967 Aug 29 to Sep 1 Summit: Arab leaders meet at Khartoum and refuse peace, recognition and negotiation with Israel.
1967 Oct Egyptian missiles sink the Israeli destroyer Eilat.
1968 Mar Israeli forces fight the PLO at Karameh in Jordan.
1968 Apr A Passover stay in Hebron leads to the founding of Kiryat Arba.
1968 May Israel Television begins regular broadcasts.
1968 Jul Palestinian gunmen hijack an El Al plane to Algiers.
1968 Dec Israeli commandos raid Beirut airport after an attack on an El Al plane in Athens.
1969 Aug A fire damages the Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem.
1969 Oct 28 Election: Alignment wins 56 seats.
14: 1972 May 30 Massacre at Lod Airport. Three Japanese gunmen working for a Palestinian group kill 26 people, most of them Puerto Rican pilgrims.
1973 Oct 6 to 25 The Yom Kippur War. Egypt and Syria attack on the holiest day of the year and Israel repels them. Ceasefires take hold on October 22 and 25. MAP 20
1974 May Massacre at Ma’alot. Gunmen seize a school in the north. Twenty-two schoolchildren are among the dead.
1978 Mar 11 The Coastal Road massacre. Gunmen land from the sea, hijack a bus and kill 38 civilians, 13 of them children.
1979 Mar 26 Peace with Egypt. The Camp David summit of September 1978 leads to the first peace treaty with an Arab state. Israel completes its return of Sinai on April 25, 1982. MAP 21
1970 Feb 21 A bomb on a Swissair plane kills 47 after takeoff from Zurich.
1972 Terrorists kill 11 Israeli athletes at the Munich Olympics.
1973 Dec 31 Election: Alignment wins 51 seats.
1974 Jan 18 Territory: Israel and Egypt sign the first Sinai disengagement agreement.
1974 Apr 11 Gunmen kill 18 people in Kiryat Shmona.
1974 May 31 Territory: Israel and Syria sign a disengagement agreement on the Golan Heights.
1974 Jun 3 Yitzhak Rabin becomes prime minister for the first time.
1975 Jul 4 A bomb in Jerusalem’s Zion Square kills 15.
1975 Sep 4 Territory: the second Sinai agreement returns the Abu Rudeis oil fields and the passes.
1976 Jul 4 Commandos rescue the hostages of a hijacked Air France plane at Entebbe.
1977 Zubin Mehta becomes music director of the Israel Philharmonic.
1977 May 17 Election: Likud wins 43 seats.
1977 Jun 20 Menachem Begin becomes prime minister after Likud wins the May 17 election, the first time Likud takes power.
1977 Nov 19 to 21 Summit: Anwar Sadat visits Jerusalem and addresses the Knesset.

1978 Mar 14 Operation Litani in southern Lebanon.
1978 Sep 5 to 17 Summit: Begin and Sadat meet with President Carter at Camp David.
1978 Dec Menachem Begin shares the Nobel Peace Prize with Anwar Sadat.
1979 Apr 22 Terrorists land by sea and attack Nahariya.

1982 Apr 25 Israel leaves Sinai. The last of the peninsula returns to Egypt under the peace treaty, and the town of Yamit is evacuated.
1982 Jun 6 The Lebanon War. Israel invades to drive out the PLO, which leaves Beirut in August. Israel stays in southern Lebanon until 2000. MAP 28
1983 Feb 8 The Kahan Commission. It finds Ariel Sharon indirectly responsible for Sabra and Shatila, and he leaves the Defense Ministry.
1984 to 1985 Operation Moses. Thousands of Ethiopian Jews are brought to Israel by way of Sudan.
1985 Jul 1 The economic stabilization plan. The unity government brings inflation of over 400 percent down within a year.
1987 Dec 8 The First Intifada. A Palestinian uprising begins in Gaza and spreads to Judea and Samaria. It lasts until 1993.
1989 The Soviet Union opens its gates. A mass aliyah begins that brings about a million Jews to Israel within a decade.
1980 Apr 7 Terrorists seize the nursery at Kibbutz Misgav Am.
1980 May 2 Gunmen kill six yeshiva students in Hebron.
1980 Jul 30 Territory: The Knesset passes the Jerusalem Law, which declares the united city the capital of Israel.
1981 Jun 30 Election: Likud wins 48 seats.
1981 Oct 6 Anwar Sadat is assassinated in Cairo.
1981 Dec 14 Territory: the Knesset applies Israeli law to the Golan Heights.
1982 Jun 3 An attack on the Israeli ambassador in London sparks the Lebanon War.
1982 Sep 16 to 18 Lebanese militias massacre Palestinians at Sabra and Shatila.
1982 Nov 11 A car bomb destroys the Israeli headquarters in Tyre.
1983 May Ofra Haza places second at the Eurovision Song Contest.
1983 May 17 Israel and Lebanon sign an agreement that is canceled in 1984.
1983 Oct 10 Yitzhak Shamir becomes prime minister.
1984 Apr 12 In the Bus 300 affair, two hijackers die in custody.
1984 Apr Security forces arrest the Jewish Underground.
1984 Jul 23 Election: Alignment 44 seats, Likud 41.

1985 Jun 10 Territory: Israel pulls back to a security zone in southern Lebanon.
1985 Oct 1 Israeli jets bomb PLO headquarters in Tunis.
1985 Oct 5 An Egyptian policeman kills seven Israeli tourists at Ras Burqa.
1985 Oct 7 Hijackers seize the cruise ship Achille Lauro.
1985 Dec 27 Gunmen attack El Al counters at Rome and Vienna airports.
1986 Yaacov Agam’s Fire and Water Fountain is installed in Dizengoff Square.
1986 Sep 6 Gunmen kill 22 worshippers at the Neve Shalom synagogue in Istanbul.
1986 Oct 16 Navigator Ron Arad is captured in Lebanon.
1986 Oct 20 Shamir returns as prime minister in the rotation.

1987 Nov 25 A hang glider attack from Lebanon kills six soldiers.
1988 Mar 7 Terrorists hijack a bus near Dimona and three civilians die.
1988 Apr 16 Abu Jihad is killed in Tunis.
1988 Jul 31 Territory: Jordan renounces its claim to Judea and Samaria.
1988 Nov 1 Election: Likud wins 40 seats.
1988 Nov 15 The PLO declares a state at its Algiers meeting.
1988 Dec 14 The United States opens a dialogue with the PLO.
16: Operation Solomon. About 14,000 Ethiopian Jews are flown to Israel in 36 hours.
1991 Jan 18 to Feb 25 Scud missiles in the Gulf War. Iraq fires about 40 missiles at Israeli cities. Israel does not respond.

1993 Sep 13 The Oslo Accords. Israel and the PLO sign the Declaration of Principles on the White House lawn. The Palestinian Authority is created. MAP 22 Three share the Nobel Peace Prize. Yitzhak Rabin, Shimon Peres and Yasser Arafat are honored for the Oslo Accords.
1994 Oct 26 Peace with Jordan. Rabin and King Hussein sign the treaty and normalize relations.
1996 Feb The Bus 18 bombings. Suicide bombers kill 45 people on Jerusalem buses in February and March.
1990 A. B. Yehoshua publishes Mr. Mani.
1990 Feb 4 Gunmen kill nine Israeli tourists on a bus in Egypt.
1990 Oct 8 Police kill 17 Palestinians in riots on the Temple Mount.
1991 Oct 30 Summit: the Madrid Peace Conference opens the first direct talks.
1991 Dec 16 The UN repeals its Zionism is racism resolution.
1992 Etgar Keret publishes his first stories, Pipelines.
1992 Jan 24 Israel and China establish diplomatic relations.
1992 Jan 29 Israel and India establish full diplomatic relations.
1992 Mar 17 A bomb destroys the Israeli embassy in Buenos Aires and 29 die.
1992 Jun 23 Election: Labor wins 44 seats.
1992 Jul 13 Yitzhak Rabin becomes prime minister for the second time.
1992 Dec 17 Israel deports 415 Hamas activists to Lebanon.
1993 Jul 25 to 31 Operation Accountability against Hezbollah.
1993 Dec 30 Israel and the Vatican sign the Fundamental Agreement.
1994 Feb 25 Baruch Goldstein kills 29 worshippers in Hebron.
1994 Apr 6 A suicide bomber kills eight on a bus in Afula.
1994 May 4 Territory: Israel withdraws from the Gaza Strip and Jericho.
1994 Jul 18 A bomb at the AMIA center in Buenos Aires kills 85.
1994 Oct 9 Hamas kidnaps soldier Nachshon Wachsman.
1994 Oct 19 A suicide bomber kills 22 on a bus on Dizengoff Street.
1995 Jan 22 Two bombs at Beit Lid kill mostly soldiers.
1995 Sep 28 Territory: the Oslo II agreement divides Judea and Samaria into Areas A, B and C.
1995 Nov 4 Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin is assassinated. Shimon Peres takes over the same day.
1996 Mar 4 A suicide bomber kills 13 at the Dizengoff Center.
1996 Mar 13 Summit: leaders meet at Sharm el-Sheikh against terrorism.
1996 Apr 11 to 27 Operation Grapes of Wrath against Hezbollah.
1996 May 29 Election: Netanyahu narrowly beats Peres.
1996 Jun 18 Benjamin Netanyahu becomes prime minister after beating Shimon Peres in the May 29 election.
1996 Sep 24 to 27 Riots follow the opening of the Western Wall Tunnel exit.
1997 Jan 15 Territory: Israel withdraws from most of Hebron under the Hebron Protocol.
1997 Feb 4 Two helicopters collide and 73 soldiers die.
1997 Jul 30 Suicide bombers kill 16 at the Mahane Yehuda market.
1997 Sep 4 Three suicide bombers kill five on Ben Yehuda Street.
1997 Sep 5 Twelve naval commandos die in an ambush in Lebanon.
1997 Sep 25 A failed Mossad plot against Khaled Mashal in Amman.
1998 Dana International wins the Eurovision Song Contest.
1998 Oct 23 Summit: Netanyahu and Arafat sign the Wye River Memorandum.
1999 Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said found the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra.
1999 May 17 Election: Barak beats Netanyahu.
1999 Jul 6 Ehud Barak becomes prime minister after beating Netanyahu on May 17.
1999 Dec 15 Summit: Israel and Syria open talks at Shepherdstown.
17: 2000 May 24 Withdrawal from Lebanon. Israel leaves southern Lebanon. The Second Intifada begins on September 28. MAP 28
2001 Mar 7 Ariel Sharon becomes prime minister. He beats Ehud Barak in the special election of February 6. He withdraws from Gaza in 2005, and a stroke ends his career in January 2006.
2001 Jun 1 The Dolphinarium bombing. A suicide bomber kills 21 people outside a Tel Aviv discotheque, most of them teenagers.
2001 Aug 9 The Sbarro bombing. A suicide bomber kills 15 people, seven of them children, in a Jerusalem pizzeria.

2002 Mar 27 The Park Hotel massacre. A suicide bomber kills 30 people at a Passover seder in Netanya. Two Technion chemists win the Nobel Prize. Aaron Ciechanover and Avram Hershko are honored for work on how cells break down proteins.
2005 Aug 15 to Sep 12 Disengagement from Gaza. Israel removes all its soldiers and communities from the Strip. MAP 23
2006 Jul 12 to Aug 14 The Second Lebanon War. It follows a cross-border Hezbollah attack and ends with a UN ceasefire. MAP 28
2007 Jun 14 Hamas takes control of Gaza. Hamas drives out the Palestinian Authority after winning elections in January 2006.
2000 Jul 11 to 25 Summit: Barak and Arafat meet at Camp David and fail to agree.
2001 Menashe Kadishman’s Fallen Leaves opens at the Jewish Museum Berlin.
2001 Feb 6 Special election: Sharon beats Barak.
2002 Israel begins building a security barrier.
2002 Daniel Kahneman wins the Nobel Prize in Economics.
2002 Amos Oz publishes A Tale of Love and Darkness.
2002 Apr 11 A truck bomb at the Djerba synagogue kills 21.
2002 Mar 29 to May 3 Operation Defensive Shield in Judea and Samaria.
2000 Sep 28 to 2005 Feb 8 The Second Intifada.
2002 Nov 28 Attacks at a hotel in Mombasa, Kenya, kill 13.
2003 Jan 28 Election: Likud wins 38 seats.
2003 Jun 4 Summit: Sharon and Abbas meet President Bush at Aqaba.
2004 Oct 7 Bombs at Taba and Ras Shitan in Sinai kill 34.
2004 Nov 11 Yasser Arafat dies.
2005 Robert Aumann wins the Nobel Prize in Economics for his work on game theory.
2005 Feb 8 Summit: Sharon and Mahmoud Abbas meet at Sharm el- Sheikh.
2006 Jan Hamas wins the Palestinian legislative elections.
2006 Mar 28 Election: Kadima wins 29 seats.
2006 Apr 14 Ehud Olmert becomes prime minister after Kadima wins on March 28.
2007 Nov 27 Summit: the Annapolis Conference relaunches talks.
2008 Waltz with Bashir wins the Golden Globe for best foreign film.
2008 Dec 27 to 2009 Jan 18 Operation Cast Lead in Gaza.
2008 Nov 26 Gunmen attack the Chabad House in Mumbai.
2009 Ada Yonath wins the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
2009 Feb 10 Election: Kadima 28 seats, Likud 27.
2009 Mar 31 Benjamin Netanyahu returns as prime minister.
18: 2014 Jul 8 to Aug 26 Operation Protective Edge. A 50-day war with Hamas follows rocket fire and the murder of three Israeli teenagers.
2018 May 14 The United States moves its embassy to Jerusalem. It follows the 2017 recognition of Jerusalem as Israel’s capital.
2010 May 31 Israeli commandos board the Gaza flotilla and nine die.
2010 Sep 2 Summit: direct talks reopen in Washington.
2010 Dec 2 The Carmel forest fire kills 44.
2011 Gilad Shalit is freed after five years in exchange for 1,000 prisoners. Iron Dome begins to operate.
2011 Dan Shechtman wins the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for the discovery of quasicrystals.
2011 Mar 11 Terrorists murder five members of the Fogel family in Itamar.
2011 Jul 14 The social justice protests begin.
2011 Aug 18 Attacks near Eilat kill eight Israelis.
2012 Mar 19 A gunman kills four at a Jewish school in Toulouse.
2012 Jul 18 A bomb in Burgas, Bulgaria, kills five Israeli tourists.
2012 Nov 14 to 21 Operation Pillar of Defense in Gaza.
2012 Nov 29 The UN General Assembly upgrades the Palestinian delegation.
2013 The singer Arik Einstein dies and crowds gather in Tel Aviv to mourn him.
2013 Jan 22 Election: Likud Beiteinu wins 31 seats.
2013 Mar 20 President Obama visits Israel.
2013 Jul 29 Summit: direct talks resume in Washington.
2014 Apr 29 The United States-led peace talks end.
2014 May 24 A gunman kills four at the Jewish Museum in Brussels.
2014 Jun 12 Three Israeli teenagers are kidnapped and murdered.
2014 Nov 18 Two attackers kill five at a synagogue in Har Nof.
2015 Jan 9 Terrorists kill four at a Paris kosher supermarket.
2015 Mar 17 Election: Likud wins 30 seats.
2015 Mar 3 Netanyahu addresses Congress on Iran.

2023 Oct 7 Hamas attacks Israel. About 1,200 people are killed and about 250 are taken hostage. Israel launches the war in Gaza, Operation Swords of Iron. MAP 24
2024 Apr 13 to 14 Iran fires missiles and drones at Israel. About 320 missiles and drones are launched. Israel says 99 percent are intercepted.

2021 May 10 to 21 Operation Guardian of the Walls.
2021 Jun 13 Naftali Bennett becomes prime minister and ends Netanyahu’s 12 years.
2022 Jul 1 Yair Lapid becomes prime minister.
2022 Dec 29 Benjamin Netanyahu returns as prime minister after the November 1 election.
